about: Dictation fixtures: 16 kHz mono PCM16 WAV plus the text the speaker meant. `speak` is what the TTS voice was given when a written word is not how people say it. See ../README.md for how they were made.

fixtures.text: Open the settings and turn on dark mode.
Please check why the login screen takes so long to load on older phones, and fix it if you can.
Can you look at the failing build and tell me which test broke after the last change?
Write a short summary of what changed today and send it to the team channel.
Stop what you are doing, revert the last commit, and run the whole test suite again before pushing.
Run npm install, then rebase this worktree onto main, fix the merge conflicts, and push the branch.
fixtures.speak: Run N P M install, then rebase this worktree onto main, fix the merge conflicts, and push the branch.

fixtures.text: Ask Claude and Codex to check the muxr host, then restart Herdr and update BYOKit to the latest version.
fixtures.speak: Ask Claude and Codex to check the muxer host, then restart Herder and update B Y O Kit to the latest version.

fixtures.text: I want to change how the terminal screen handles long output. Right now when an agent prints a lot of text, the screen jumps back to the top and I lose my place. Keep the scroll position where it was unless I am already at the bottom. Also add a small button that takes me back to the latest output, and make sure it works on both phones and tablets.
Tell Codex to open a pull request for the dictation fix and ask Claude to review it. If the checks pass, merge it into main and clean up the worktree. Then send me a note in muxr with the link.
fixtures.speak: Tell Codex to open a pull request for the dictation fix and ask Claude to review it. If the checks pass, merge it into main and clean up the worktree. Then send me a note in muxer with the link.

fixtures.text: Show me the last error from the build log and explain what it means.
Move the save button to the top of the screen so it is easier to reach.
First, pull the latest changes. Then run the tests. If anything fails, send me the output.
